summary: Seven metres of roundabout island kerb beside an arterial; nowhere to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Houses are 34 m or more away, but the island sits in open carriageway.
drivers.access_and_room: The line runs along the island edge; a van would stand in the circulating lane.
drivers.traffic: Roundabout next to a multi-lane arterial with a bus stop.
drivers.convention: No parked cars and no signs.

flags: Roundabout: stopping blocks the circulating lane
sun_shade: Open to sun; trees shade the west and south-west.
